description: Comprehensive verified catalog of ballistic missiles, hypersonic weapons, cruise missiles, air defense systems, CIWS anti-air guns, and loitering munitions / drones.

weapons.name: MGM-140 ATACMS (M57 Unitary)
weapons.flight_profile: Quasi-ballistic with terminal dive and pull-up evasive maneuvers
weapons.warhead_type: WAU-23/B 500 lb class Unitary HE Blast-Fragmentation
weapons.description: Tactical ballistic missile fired from M142 HIMARS and M270 MLRS, designed for precision deep strikes against high-value air defense, command centers, and logistics nodes.

weapons.name: 9K720 Iskander-M (9M723)
weapons.flight_profile: Quasi-ballistic aeroballistic trajectory with high-G evasive maneuvering (up to 30g) and active decoy release (9B899)
weapons.guidance: GLONASS/INS + Optical scene-matching / Active Radar terminal seeker
weapons.description: Road-mobile theater quasi-ballistic missile featuring unpredictable flight paths, radar-absorbent coatings, and penetration aids engineered to defeat theater air defense systems.

weapons.name: Dong Feng-21D (DF-21D ASBM)
weapons.flight_profile: Medium-range ballistic trajectory with terminal Maneuvering Reentry Vehicle (MaRV) targeting moving naval vessels
weapons.guidance: Inertial + BeiDou satellite navigation + Active Radar / Millimeter-Wave and Optical terminal homing
weapons.description: Medium-Range Ballistic Missile designated the world first Anti-Ship Ballistic Missile (ASBM), engineered to target aircraft carrier strike groups.

weapons.name: LGM-30G Minuteman III
weapons.flight_profile: Three-stage solid-fuel Keplerian exo-atmospheric intercontinental ballistic trajectory with post-boost vehicle (PBV)
weapons.guidance: NS-50 Advanced Inertial Navigation System (PIGA accelerometer)
weapons.warhead_type: Thermonuclear MIRV (W78 335kt / W87 300kt on Mk-12A/Mk-21 RV)
weapons.description: Silo-based intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) constituting the land-based leg of the U.S. nuclear triad, capable of precision global strikes.

weapons.name: RS-28 Sarmat (SS-X-29 / SS-X-30 Satan II)
weapons.flight_profile: Liquid-propellant super-heavy ICBM with Fractional Orbital Bombardment System (FOBS) capability and south pole trajectory options
weapons.warhead_type: Multiple Independently Targetable Reentry Vehicles (10-15 MIRVs) or Avangard Hypersonic Glide Vehicles (HGV)
weapons.description: Super-heavy liquid-fueled silo-based ICBM designed to bypass anti-ballistic missile defense systems via global fractional orbital vectors and massive decoy payloads.

weapons.name: Dong Feng-17 (DF-17 HGV)
weapons.flight_profile: Hypersonic Boost-Glide: rocket boost followed by atmospheric waverider skip-glide (40-60 km) with high lateral cross-range maneuverability
weapons.guidance: BeiDou satellite navigation + Inertial guidance with terminal optical/active radar homing
weapons.description: Medium-range ballistic missile booster mated to the DF-ZF hypersonic glide vehicle, flying below typical anti-ballistic missile intercept ceilings while out-maneuvering traditional air defense.

weapons.name: Kh-47M2 Kinzhal
weapons.flight_profile: Air-launched aeroballistic trajectory released at supersonic speeds/high altitude with midcourse pull-up and terminal evasive dive
weapons.guidance: GLONASS/INS with active radar / optical scene correlation terminal seeker
weapons.description: Air-launched nuclear-capable aeroballistic hypersonic missile launched from modified MiG-31K interceptors and Tu-22M3 bombers.

weapons.name: 3M22 Zircon (SS-N-33)
weapons.flight_profile: Scramjet-powered hypersonic cruise in the upper stratosphere (~28-30 km) followed by high-speed terminal dive onto maritime or coastal targets
weapons.guidance: Inertial + GLONASS midcourse + Active/Passive Radar seeker terminal
weapons.warhead_type: Semi-Armor Piercing HE Blast-Fragmentation / Nuclear option
weapons.description: Ship and submarine-launched scramjet-powered hypersonic cruise missile engineered to neutralize aircraft carrier strike groups and land installations.

weapons.name: AGM-183A ARRW (Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon)
weapons.manufacturer: Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control
weapons.flight_profile: Air-launched rocket boost-glide profile; solid rocket booster accelerates wedge-shaped glide vehicle into upper atmosphere for hypersonic glide
weapons.guidance: GPS-aided INS with advanced autonomous terminal guidance package
weapons.warhead_type: Kinetic Energy Impact / Lethal Fragmenting Blast Warhead
weapons.description: Air Force hypersonic boost-glide weapon deployed from B-52H Stratofortress, designed to engage heavily defended, time-critical, high-value land targets.

weapons.name: BGM-109 Tomahawk (Block V)
weapons.flight_profile: Very low-altitude terrain-contour-matching subsonic cruise with low radar cross section (RCS)
weapons.guidance: GPS + INS + TERCOM (Terrain Contour Matching) + DSMAC (Digital Scene Matching Area Correlation) + two-way satellite datalink
weapons.warhead_type: WDU-36/B Unitary HE Blast-Fragmentation (1,000 lb class)
weapons.description: Long-range, all-weather, jet-powered, surface- and submarine-launched precision land-attack cruise missile (TLAM) with loitering and in-flight retargeting.

weapons.name: 3M-54 / 3M-14 Kalibr (SS-N-27 Sizzler / SS-N-30A)
weapons.flight_profile: Sea-skimming / terrain-following subsonic cruise with supersonic multi-axis terminal pop-up and sprint
weapons.guidance: GLONASS/INS + ARGS-54 Active Radar seeker / DSMAC optical correlation
weapons.description: Russian multi-role cruise missile system deployed on surface combatants and submarines, capable of strategic land attack and supersonic anti-ship strikes.

weapons.name: Storm Shadow / SCALP-EG
weapons.flight_profile: Stealth low-observable terrain-following subsonic cruise with autonomous terminal pop-up, target recognition, and steep dive
weapons.guidance: GPS + Inertial Navigation + TERPROM (Terrain Profile Matching) + Terminal Imaging Infrared (IIR) with Automatic Target Recognition (ATR)
weapons.warhead_type: BROACH (Bomb Royal Ordnance Augmented Charge) two-stage tandem penetrating warhead
weapons.description: Air-launched, long-range, deep-strike cruise missile engineered with low-observable stealth characteristics to destroy hardened bunkers, bridges, and command centers.

weapons.name: BrahMos (PJ-10)
weapons.flight_profile: Ramjet-powered high-low or low-low supersonic trajectory with high-G terminal weaving maneuvers
weapons.guidance: Inertial + GPS/GLONASS/GAGAN + Active Radar Homing terminal seeker
weapons.description: World fastest operational supersonic ramjet cruise missile, deployable from land launchers, naval warships, submarines, and Su-30MKI aircraft.

weapons.name: Anduril Barracuda-100
weapons.flight_profile: Air-breathing turbojet Autonomous Air Vehicle (AAV) cruise with 5g maneuvering and folding aerodynamic surfaces
weapons.guidance: Lattice OS autonomous collaborative mission execution + GPS/INS + terminal optical/RF seeker
weapons.description: Hyper-scale manufacturable air-breathing autonomous strike vehicle designed for high-density cooperative strike and mass attrition against contested air defenses.

weapons.name: Anduril Barracuda-250
weapons.flight_profile: Extended-range turbojet autonomous air-breathing cruise compatible with tactical fighter wing pylons and internal weapons bays
weapons.guidance: Lattice OS collaborative swarming + GPS/INS + terminal multi-mode seeker
weapons.description: Tactical air-launched cruise munition designed for internal carriage in 5th-gen fighters (F-35) and external carriage on 4th-gen aircraft to strike theater targets.

weapons.name: Anduril Barracuda-500 (AGM-189A)
weapons.flight_profile: Long-range autonomous turbojet cruise (>2 hours loiter endurance), palletized Rapid Dragon launch compatible from C-17/C-130 and bombers
weapons.guidance: Lattice OS distributed swarm autonomy + anti-jam GPS/INS + EO/IR terminal seeker
weapons.description: Long-range Autonomous Air Vehicle designated AGM-189A by the U.S. military, capable of mass palletized deployment for standoff theater strike and theater air defense saturation.
